# SetTextAreaText

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Text Areas](BlitzPlus-Text-Areas)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetTextAreaText:Void textarea:Int32, text:String, pos:Int32=0, len:Int32=-1, units:Int32=1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `textarea` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a text area. |
| `text` | In | String | required | The text to write. |
| `pos` | In | Int32 | `0` |  |
| `len` | In | Int32 | `-1` |  |
| `units` | In | Int32 | `1` | 1 counts characters, 2 counts lines. Defaults to 1. |

## Description

Writes text into a text area at a place. It replaces the given number of characters or lines there, so a length of 0 only inserts.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Insert", 10, 10, 300, 150, Desktop(), 3)
area = CreateTextArea(10, 10, 270, 90, win)
SetGadgetText area, "Hello world"
SetTextAreaText area, "big ", 6, 0
SetTextAreaText area, "HELLO", 0, 5
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
